limits: Callback elapsed time is not a complete CPU attribution; WebSocket framing/UTF8 validation/TLS, initial Buffer conversion, socket-counter handling, garbage collection and other runtime work are not isolated by watchProcessingMs.
No full broad-feed archive exists by design; selected retained packets are not a representative broad-feed CPU sample.
Local filtering cannot reduce traffic already delivered. Hints are not complete executed flow or predictive evidence.
decision: Do not replace an existing selective parser with O(1) identity lookup with another parser to address the180-second total CPU stop without a whole-runtime profile. No runtime change made.
